info.title: unlimotion-cli
info.description: CLI for inspecting and updating Unlimotion task graphs with availability rules.

options.name: --tasks
options.description:
unlimotion-cli unlocked --tasks <path> [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli unlocked [--root <task-id>]... --tasks <path> [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli candidates --tasks <path> --limit <1..100> [--status <status>] [--startable true|false] [--sort default] [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli claim --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --agent <agent-id> --expected-status Prepared [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli execution question --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --agent <agent-id> --lease <lease-id> --text <text> [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli execution answer --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --agent <agent-id> --lease <lease-id> --question-id <question-id> --text <text> [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli execution result|complete --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --agent <agent-id> --lease <lease-id> --summary <text> [--link <absolute-uri>] [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli release --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --agent <agent-id> --lease <lease-id> --reason <text> [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli create --tasks <path> --title <text> [--description <text>] [--parent <task-id>] [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli apply --tasks <path> --request <path|-> [--dry-run] [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli task --tasks <path> --id <task-id> [--include details,relations,criteria,history,execution] [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli validate --tasks <path> [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli set-status --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --status <status> [--author <name>] [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli complete --tasks <path> --id <task-id> [--author <name>] [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli set-criterion --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --criterion <criterion-id> --satisfied true|false [--format text|json]
unlimotion-cli satisfy-criterion --tasks <path> --id <task-id> --criterion <criterion-id> [--format text|json]
